description: This PHP class 'ClaimAttachmentController' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Claim plugin. It extends an abstract file controller to handle HTTP requests related to claim attachments, including validating requests, retrieving claim data, access control, and serving attachment files.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling claim attachment retrieval requests, validating user permissions, and serving the attachment files.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the HTTP request to retrieve a claim attachment. Validates request parameters, checks user access, fetches the attachment, sets response headers, and returns the file content if successful.
